name: satelink-mcp
description: Pay-per-call Polygon PoS (chain 137) JSON-RPC over MCP. First calls each day are free; after that, calls settle automatically via x402 (USDC on Base) — $0.10 buys a 1,000-call bundle. No account, no subscription.

env.SATELINK_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY: 0x private key of a Base-funded USDC wallet; enables automatic x402 payment.
env.SATELINK_API_KEY: Optional Satelink API key for higher free-tier limits.
